title: soft_sign: unguarded size_t->word32 cast in ECDSA/RSA/EDDSA
description: wp11_backend_soft.c soft_sign() casts *siglen directly to word32 for ECDSA, ECDSA_SHA256, RSA_PKCS, and EDDSA paths without a WP11_FITS_U32 guard. The EDDSA and RSA paths have the guard for inlen but not for *siglen. On LP64, a caller passing *siglen > UINT32_MAX causes wolfCrypt to write a signature into a buffer it believes is larger than it is.
